items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...after he had a very serious accident in which he and Jane, his wife, were seriously injured. [INTERVIEWEE] That could be.

ctx.x: But I can see his point about wanting to forget that whole period. Naturally, if I was him I'd want to forget it. It's not going to throw a good light on him. He wasn't a very nice person. What he did wasn't very nice, to a lot of people, not only to me, but to a lot of people.
I understand that he changed, his personality changed, became more mellow, after he had a very serious accident in which he and Jane, his wife, were seriously injured.
